scope: Full coordinated 0.7.0 framework comparison including direct server prop normalization

methodology.rendering: Same authored and compiled component across Node/Bun string/stream. String uses the public hydratable renderer and buffered response factory; streaming uses the public progressive response renderer. Node writes to its socket; Bun consumes a bounded native Web stream.
limitations: Same measurement protocols as the previous full baseline, with browser and SSR round ordering advanced from 23 to 24.
Historical focused diagnostics retain their own source identities and do not measure this revision.
Timings reflect the recorded host and runtime; rebuilding the source does not reproduce identical timings.
This is a new full run, not a matched old/new experiment. Differences from the historical capture do not isolate source changes from host and control variation.

limitations: Native participants share domain semantics but use separate process-local stores and transports.
Browser and server samples use sequential local loopback probes without throttling.

hostSession.note: Dedicated clean worktree at bbf2a9e4. No restart requested for this run. Timed collectors run sequentially in one private native-loopback network namespace.

admissionEnvironment.webkit: Installed local libicu78 and preserved LD_LIBRARY_PATH in cached minibrowser-wpe launcher. Skipped ldconfig-only host preflight for privately installed libraries. All Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit real-WebGL assertions passed.
admissionEnvironment.retries: Initial cold ESLint exceeded default Node heap. Admission retry completed all release checks except initial WebKit launch. R3F matrix rerun passed after local environment correction. Remaining admission checks run separately.
admissionEnvironment.additionalChecks: Router v6.3 passed. Theme Lab 11/11 passed after sample layout and platform baseline repair committed in a9b48e5d. Native compiler corpus functional/structural checks passed, concurrent timing warning excluded from performance evidence.
admissionEnvironment.revision: Initial admission bbf2a9e4. Advanced clean benchmark checkout to a9b48e5d for documentation, extension version metadata, and Theme Lab sample/test fixes. Framework implementation unchanged.

timingReview.reason: native compiler corpus timing ratio 2.05 exceeded 1.50

shippingMemory.initialFailure: Manual Vitest configurations did not load the optional-enhancement resolver. Fixed by sharing the application test configuration.
shippingMemory.heap: Full 1100-render attempt stopped after exceeding the original 120-second test budget. A three-render diagnostic passed the retained-owner assertions, which does not establish a heap plateau.
shippingMemory.allocation: A diagnostic with one warmup and two measured requests estimated 1844174784 allocated bytes per request against a 5767168-byte ceiling. This is abbreviated diagnostic evidence, not the full 100-warmup/200-request guard.

productionVerification.mode: Vite SSR production bundle, same shipping fixture, five sequential renders, local host without network service

shippingMemory.finding: Theme scope resolution recomputes palettes for each fresh request-owned definition. Profiling identified color conversion and contrast calculations as the dominant work. No matched older revision was measured, so this does not establish when the cost was introduced.
shippingMemory.followup: Investigate reusable bounded theme derivation across equivalent scope definitions while preserving inheritance, preferences, ownership, and cleanup. Re-run full shipping heap and allocation guards after the repair.

source.diagnosticChanges: Same framework and fixture implementation. Both manual configs spread the normal app Vitest config. The heap diagnostic changes batchSize 200 to 1, batchCount 5 to 2, warmups 100 to 1. The allocation diagnostic changes warmups 100 to 1, measured requests and divisor 200 to 2. Those diagnostic reductions were reverted and are not changes to the maintained guards.
source.productionProbe: Vite build with application cwd/root, configFile false, exact target server with serverComponents true, ssr.noExternal true, entry manual/test-support/shipping-ssr-fixture.ts. Import the resulting fixture, create once, await five sequential render calls, dispose in finally. NODE_ENV=production. Build and import outside timing.

focusedDiagnostics.controlProvenance: Copied pre-remediation compiled entries and worker, with current external platform admission modules. The control is not a pristine historical checkout.
focusedDiagnostics.prototypeProvenance: Ignored copies of compiled bundles with the named perturbations; no prototype source/build archives retained. A source SHA alone does not reconstruct these variants.
focusedDiagnostics.method: Two reversed process populations, native isolated loopback, two drivers, identical response hashes. String arrivals: 30 s warmup and 60 s at 10k offered RPS. Concurrency probes: 10 s warmup and 30 s measurement.

variants.aligned: Measured public response path at the implementation commit
variants.noTail: Skip encoding an empty final Unicode tail; cost probe only
variants.noCount: Omit progressive byte-limit accounting; correctness-reducing cost probe, not a shipping candidate
variants.noBoundary: Return render completion directly and unlink cancellation early; loses asynchronous error recovery and cancellation guarantees, not a shipping candidate
variants.thin: Replace the async producer completion frame with promise success/error continuations while retaining cleanup
variants.noEvents: Await start/complete event emission only when it returns a promise

focusedDiagnostics.conclusion: Matched Node string and Bun string checks did not reproduce their historical-chart regressions. Bun streaming retained an approximately 3% direct-path deficit. Completion handling contributes; the remaining cost is not fully isolated. No probe was adopted.

bunChunkedTransfer.prototypeProvenance: Ignored copied adapter bundles modify response delivery only; authored and compiled components are unchanged. The source SHA alone cannot reconstruct these uncommitted prototypes.
bunChunkedTransfer.method: Two reversed populations per comparison, fresh service/worker/two drivers per variant, 10 s warmup and 15 s each at concurrency 16 and 128 on native isolated loopback; matching decoded response hashes.

variants.yieldfirst: Same queue, await setImmediate after first nonempty byte enqueue
variants.timerfirst: Same queue, await setTimeout(0) after first nonempty byte enqueue
variants.all: Native Bun direct stream, shared Unicode-safe encoder, flush(true) after every nonempty write; rejects subsequent pull production once started

wire.pendingTailFraming: chunked; head arrives before the 40 ms gated tail
wire.explicitHeader: Does not override native Content-Length for immediately completed output
wire.deferredStart: Deferring all production alone does not force chunking

bunChunkedTransfer.rejectedDirectFirst: Two multi-process preflight attempts failed with HPE_INVALID_CONSTANT. A concurrent request probe observed duplicate terminating chunks. Sequential requests passed. Root cause is not established beyond this prototype.
bunChunkedTransfer.directBackpressure: Native HTTP slow-reader probes stopped production and explicit cancellation unwound before scope release. A JavaScript-reader probe buffered approximately 8 MiB despite a requested 32 KiB bound; this blocks general adoption.
bunChunkedTransfer.conclusion: All valid forced-chunking candidates reduced throughput in both populations. No runtime change adopted; full accepted baseline and public chart data remain unchanged.

correctness.controlled: Node and Bun, string and stream browser contracts passed

retention.note: Only bounded summaries and chart data are retained in Git; raw capture hashes identify local measurement inputs.
